Name: DCBurger style Marnie Sprite for VSCO
Author: CritMe20
Description:
[b]This is a textures only mod! Its intention is to replace Marnie's sprite sheets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1942]Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul[/url].
[/b]These textures replace both Marnie and Marnie_Beach sprite sheets with a DCBurger Style slightly cuter Marnie sprite, recommended to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait Mod[/url]﻿.

In order for the new Marnie Sprite to work you must first download and extract [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1942]Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul[/url]﻿[/b] to your "Mods" file!

[b]Installation
[/b]﻿1. Download and extract the file.
2. Copy & Paste Marnie and Marnie_Beach sprite sheets to Mods/[CP] Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul/assets/characters
3. Replace existing files.

You're welcome to use these textures with other Sprite mods as long as there are Sprite Sheets to replace with mine, however remember to rename my texture files to the ones you're going to replace so the sprite will show up in game!!
